title: Jessica Utts' presidential address on psychic functioning evidence

tellings.quote: she was the you know the president of the American statistical society and stuff one year

plain: The statistician Jessica Utts, who studied the evidence for psychic abilities, is said to have served a year as president of the American Statistical Association, and to have used her presidential address in 2016 to talk about that evidence. The writer Eric Wargo, who writes about precognition and dreams, mentions it to Michels without a source, saying she 'was the president of the American statistical society and stuff one year.' He raises it as a sign that a leading figure in a mainstream science treated the evidence seriously.
